heading: Team photo options
intro: Three options for each person, side by side. Column B keeps their real face and just makes the set consistent. Column C is an AI-generated headshot, which looks the most polished but is a synthetic likeness rather than a real photograph, so it should only go live if each person is happy with it.
note: Nothing here is live on the site. The real About page still shows the current photos (column A).

columns.label: A. Current
columns.note: What is live now: the original supplied photos, inconsistent framing and backgrounds.

columns.label: B. Cleaned real photo
columns.note: Their actual face, cut out and placed on one matched studio grey, uniform framing. Genuinely them.

columns.label: C. AI-generated
columns.note: A synthetic studio headshot generated from their photo. Polished, but a regenerated likeness, not a real photo. Needs each person’s consent before publishing.
